column1: # anchors.tsv -- the title's 13 regression legs (the battery of verify/battery.py / gate_run.py), one row per leg.
# Derived from each leg's frozen `baseline/<leg>/{run.meta,frames.fhash,probe/,LEG.tsv}` (P8.36-D); the runners
# still enumerate `baseline/` directly -- this file is the human index and the cross-check (ctest VerifyAnchorsTable).
# Columns: name | kind (coldboot / anchor / slowspot / attract) | anchor (the savestate the leg restores, relative to
# the OLD root `--repo`, or `coldboot`) | frames (the frozen lane length = the leg's run length; coldboot_attract's
# LEG.tsv `frames` 6000 presented 5993 lines) | probes (the frozen OLD probe boundaries under baseline/<leg>/probe/) |
# probe_dir | pad_script (`-`: every leg replays the harness's neutral pad; no leg has a script) |
# source (old = frozen from the OLD binary 2026-09-25/26 and 2026-10-05; new = frozen from NEW, policy 2026-10-06 item 3).
